BiblicalUsage: The word is a division, a classification, and it appears once, at Josiah's Passover, when the burnt offerings were set aside according to the divisions of the families of the people.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that order is part of worship: every family had its place at the Passover, and no one was left out.
